title: Exotic Sri Lanka Super Deluxe for Couples: Kandy, Nuwara Eliya and Bentota
alt: A couple watching the sunset from a beach resort at Bentota
transport: Private air conditioned car with an English speaking chauffeur guide throughout

stops.name: Kandy
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Hillside hotel with a pool above Kandy lake

activities.name: Private visit to Pinnawala
activities.description: A stop on the way up from the airport to watch the resident herd bathe in the Maha Oya river and feed at the sanctuary.

activities.name: Private lake drive and Kandyan dance show
activities.description: An evening circuit of the lake followed by a traditional performance of drummers, masked dancers and the closing fire walk.

activities.name: Private full day Kandy sightseeing
activities.description: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, the Peradeniya botanical gardens, the Bahiravokanda Buddha and the gem museum.

program.name: Kandy
program.description: Two nights above Kandy lake with a private elephant visit on the way in, a private dance show and a private full day of the city and its gardens.

stops.name: Nuwara Eliya
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 4★ · Four star colonial cottage hotel above Nuwara Eliya

activities.name: Private full day Nuwara Eliya sightseeing
activities.description: Ramboda Falls, a working tea estate and factory, Gregory Lake, Victoria Park, Hakgala gardens and the Seetha Amman temple.

program.name: Nuwara Eliya
program.description: Up into the tea country for a night in a four star colonial cottage with a private full day of waterfalls, gardens and lake.

stops.name: Bentota
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 4★ · Four star beachfront resort on the Bentota strand

activities.name: Private full day Bentota sightseeing
activities.description: The Madu Ganga boat ride, the Kosgoda turtle hatchery, the Galapatha temple and an afternoon on Bentota beach.

activities.name: Private excursion to Mirissa
activities.description: Along the southern coast to Mirissa beach and Coconut Tree Hill, with the Galle fort on the way back.

program.name: Bentota
program.description: Three nights at a four star beachfront resort: a free day on arrival, a private day of the Madu River and the turtles, and a private excursion to Mirissa.

stops.name: Colombo
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Modern city hotel in the Colombo Fort district

activities.name: Private full day Colombo sightseeing
activities.description: Galle Face Green, the Gangaramaya temple, the colonial Fort district, the Lotus Tower and the floating market at Pettah.

program.name: Colombo
program.description: A last night in the Fort district with a private full day of the capital.

day_titles.1: Arrival in Colombo and on to Kandy

1: Arrival at Bandaranaike International and private transfer inland
A stop at the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary on the way
Check in at your Kandy hotel in the afternoon
An evening lake drive and the Kandyan dance performance
2: Breakfast, then the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
The Peradeniya Royal Botanical Gardens and the orchid house
The hilltop Buddha at Bahiravokanda and the gem museum
Dinner at the hotel overlooking the lake
3: Breakfast and a private transfer up to Nuwara Eliya
Ramboda Falls and a tea factory tasting on the way
Gregory Lake, Victoria Park and the Hakgala gardens
Check in at your colonial cottage and dinner
4: Breakfast and a long transfer down to Bentota
Check in at your four star beachfront resort
The rest of the day at leisure on the sand
Optional: a sunset catamaran ride on the Bentota river
5: Breakfast, then a boat safari through the Madu Ganga mangroves
The cinnamon island and the fish spa at the river mouth
The Kosgoda turtle hatchery in the afternoon
Optional: a candlelit dinner on the beach
6: Breakfast and a private excursion along the southern coast
Mirissa beach and the palms of Coconut Tree Hill
The Galle Dutch fort on the way back
7: Breakfast and a transfer up the coast to Colombo
Galle Face Green and the Gangaramaya temple complex
The Fort district, the Lotus Tower and Pettah market
Dinner and your last night at the hotel
8: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Bandaranaike International for your flight home

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Bentota is where the trip exhales. After the temples and tea estates, three nights by the water is exactly the right medicine.
expert.tip: Ask for an early start on the Galle day. The fort ramparts are empty before ten and the light on the lighthouse is at its best.

summary: The Exotic Sri Lanka couples route in upgraded hotels: two nights above Kandy lake, a four star colonial cottage in the tea country, three nights at a four star beach resort in Bentota with the Madu River, the turtles and Mirissa, and a final night in Colombo.
included: Included: 7 nights in deluxe and four star hotels with breakfast and lunch or dinner daily; private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; private Pinnawala visit; private Kandy lake drive and dance show; private full day Kandy sightseeing; private full day Nuwara Eliya sightseeing; private full day Bentota sightseeing; a private excursion to Mirissa; private full day Colombo sightseeing.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches unless stated; entrance tickets where marked as payable locally; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
